atoms.text:
Conditional clauses bestehen aus zwei Teilen, dem if clause und dem main clause. Der if-clause beschreibt eine Bedingung. Der main clause sagt aus, was passieren könnte, wenn die Bedingung erfüllt wird.

Wenn im Satz der if-clause vorne steht, folgt darauf ein Komma.

example.a: <m-yellow>If I find my yellow pencil</m-yellow>, <m-blue> I will draw a sunset</m-blue>.
example.sound: If I find my yellow pencil, I will draw a sunset

atoms.b: ((If Mila practices dancing every day)), she_will_become_a_professional_dancer.

instruction.text: Welche Satzstellung benötigt ein Komma? Ziehe es an die richtige Stelle.

atoms.b:
If you go to the supermarket today((,))can you buy a chocolate bar for me?

Can you buy a chocolate bar for me if you go to the supermarket today?
atoms.sound: If you go to the supermarket today, can you buy a chocolate bar for me? Can you buy a chocolate bar for me if you go to the supermarket today?

atoms.b:
If you go to the cinema this weekend((,))I might join you.

I might join you if you go to the cinema this weekend.
atoms.sound: If you go to the cinema this weekend, I might join you. I might join you if you go to the cinema this weekend.

atoms.b:
We might see the stars at night if we are lucky.

If we are lucky((,))we might see the stars at night.
atoms.sound: We might see the stars at night if we are lucky. If we are lucky, we might see the stars at night.

atoms.b:
If he speaks Spanish regularly((,))he will get better.

He will get better if he speaks Spanish regularly.
atoms.sound: If he speaks Spanish regularly, he will get better. He will get better if he speaks Spanish regularly.
